StockPal review for micro bakeries

StockPal is built for restaurant chains. For a micro bakery it is overkill: setup took a full weekend and the cheapest plan costs more than our monthly flour order. Barcode scanning does not help because we buy flour in bulk sacks.

What small bakeries need is low-stock alerts, recipe-based usage estimates and expiry reminders for dairy, without the enterprise features. Many reviewers ask for a cheaper plan aimed at home bakers and market stalls.
